Prevention: Rotation with crops from a different family
Remove and dispose of all previous
Solanaceous crop residues that may act as host.
Solarisation as a possible alternative to killing adult weevil in soil.
Monitoring: Twice weekly scouting to ascertain the presence of pest.
Look for discolouration of the main stem where leaves join
Plants showing discolouration should be split open to observe a white “larva” with a brown head and tunnels in the stem.
If one plant in a hundred is infested action should be taken
Direct Control: Remove and dispose all infected plant material
Host weeds such as (Jumbie tomato) should be removed from surrounding fields, since they act as host.
Restrictions: Wear protective clothing when handling chemicals.
Rotate chemicals where possible (change the chemical you are using) regularly to prevent the pest becoming resistant.
